title: Building an Agent Loop
tagline: The core of turbo-agent-kit, no framework, ~300 lines
interviewPrompt: build the core of an LLM agent loop from scratch, no framework

beats.interviewer: For today's software engineering interview: build the core of an LLM agent loop from scratch, no framework. Start with the shape.
beats.interviewee: Complete naive loop first: user message in, orchestrator calls the model, final text out. No tools yet, but it is a full turn.
beats.show: Naive complete: User → Orchestrator → LLM → Final Message.

beats.interviewer: What's the data model underneath it?
beats.interviewee: Same complete turn. The conversation is an ordered list of messages: user, assistant, tool. Orchestrator owns the turn.
beats.show: Same full path. Data model: ordered user/assistant/tool messages.

beats.interviewer: How does the model actually decide to use a tool?
beats.interviewee: Each step still goes through the full path: hand history to the model, get final text or a tool call. Branch is the only new idea.
beats.show: Full turn: complete() returns final text or a tool call.

beats.interviewee: Here is the complete tool-using system: up to five steps, final or tool, registry lookup, push result, loop. Cap stops infinite spins.
beats.show: Complete loop: complete → final-or-tool, max 5 steps.

beats.interviewer: Say it asks for a tool. What happens then?
beats.interviewee: On the full system: name lookup in the registry, zod-validate args, run, push tool result, call the model again.
beats.show: Full tool path: registry lookup + zod, then back into the loop.

beats.interviewer: How do you stop the model from calling a tool with garbage arguments?
beats.interviewee: Every tool is defined with a zod schema. run parses before the body. Bad args never reach my code. Same complete loop.
beats.show: Same complete system. defineTool zod-parses before run.

beats.interviewer: And you feed the result back into the model?
beats.interviewee: Yes. Tool output re-enters the conversation on the same complete loop, capped at five steps.
beats.show: Full loop closed: tool result → orchestrator → model again.

beats.interviewer: Anything you would add before we wrap?
beats.interviewee: Telemetry on every model and tool call, and onMessage so the UI streams the turn. Full production agent loop.
beats.show: Complete production: loop + tools + telemetry + stream out.
